description: Source code for a mention parser in the Mattermost project, handling user and group mentions within text messages.

classes.name: StandardMentionParser
classes.description: A parser for detecting mentions in text, including system mentions (@here, @channel, @all) and keyword-based mentions.

methods.name: ProcessText
methods.description: Processes input text to identify and record mentions and potential mentions.

methods.name: checkForMention
methods.description: Checks if a word is a mention to a user, group, or system mention.

methods.name: addMentions
methods.description: Adds mention IDs to the results based on mention type.

methods.name: isKeywordMultibyte
methods.description: Checks if a word contains multibyte keywords and returns matching IDs.
